note: §6.1 confidentiality sentence, whole-stack: TestRFC8414MetadataFetchUsesConfidentialIntegritySuite + the fetch negotiates TLS with a suite in tls.CipherSuites and not in tls.InsecureCipherSuites; - a cleartext server behind an https issuer (nil client, the production path of buildAuthForMode) and a TLS 1.2 server offering only TLS_RSA_WITH_RC4_128_SHA each give zero metadata with neither handler reached. The suite refusal is performed by Go's crypto/tls default client suite list, which Ze keeps by never setting TLSClientConfig in oauthHTTPClient; the RC4 case uses the httptest client (to isolate this from the 6.1-3 certificate check), so a caller passing a custom insecure transport is not exercised. Records are whole-function panic breaks of fetchASMetadata (+) and oauthHTTPClient (-).
